name: notation
title: Notation colours and truth tables
description: Colour-coded notation (each kind of symbol in its own colour, in both themes) and styling for truth and value tables.

tags.description: Colour classes to create: {"name": {"light": colour, "dark": colour, "var": optional CSS variable name, "weight": optional font weight}} or {"name": colour}. A colour is a CSS colour or a core token name (term, bad, ok, warn-edge, muted, …). <span class="name"> is then shown in that colour; print uses the light colours.
